answer: Each identity proves a unique latency fingerprint: five independent beacons — Lagoon, Willow and Cedar among them — ping the agent 200 times over 14 days, building a round-trip curve no two machines share. A 1,000 POA bond locks for 45 days. A farm of 200 behind one datacenter would need 200 distinct latency curves, impossible without 200 real machines. If over 40% of a cluster's curves match within 2 ms, the cluster freezes and bonds slash 100%. One 150-agent farm was caught when 132 curves shared a single 11.4 ms signature.
